text:
Maya (PM): Heads-up: exploring a bulk-rotate flow for API keys used by teams. Goal: let infra owners rotate multiple keys at once with optional rollout windows and an approval step.
Jon (eng): Nice. Main constraints: we need to support per-key overlap windows and a group-level orchestrated rollout. Backend can chain rotations but UI needs to show status clearly.
Rin (design): Mocked two UX paths: 1) checklist modal that lists selected keys with per-key options; 2) a compact bulk drawer that lets you apply a single policy to all. Link: https://figma.com/s/bulk-rotate
Omar (security): Approval step mandatory for orgs with >5 seats. Approval copy should call out "This action will create new secrets and may cause brief auth interruptions". Also audit log entry required.
Zoe (a11y): A11y: bulk modal must be keyboard operable and announce a summary of how many keys will be rotated (e.g., "Rotating 8 keys: 3 with 30m overlap, 5 immediate"). Use aria-live.
Maya (PM): Copy options: primary CTA: "Schedule rotate" when using windows, else "Rotate now". Confirmation text: "Rotation will create new secrets. Download or store them securely — secrets are shown once." Keep it short.
Jon (eng): Implementation note: per-key "grace" counts. For bulk, we'll show a per-key status line during rollout: queued -> rotating -> overlap -> done/failed. Expose retry for failed ones.
Rin (design): Visuals: progress bar with segmented per-key ticks, small inline toast for errors. For large batches, add a summary email option: "Send results to: team@acme.com".
Omar (security): Make sure rotation events appear in audit-bot. Also require a second confirmation for keys with admin scopes. Suggested language: "This will rotate an admin-scoped key. Confirm to proceed." Type-to-confirm optional.
audit-bot: audit:event created: bulk_rotate requested by Maya (org:acme)
Zoe (a11y): For results, provide a machine-readable CSV download of outcomes with headers: key_id, status, new_secret_hint. Ensure the success toast uses role="status" so screen readers get it.
Maya (PM): Edge cases: if rotation creates a new secret but client can't fetch it, we need a clear recovery path: link to "Create replacement key" and docs on how to update SDKs.
Jon (eng): We'll also add a 'dry run' mode that simulates rotation and surfaces potential breaking clients (based on last-used / IP telemetry). UI label: "Preview changes".
Rin (design): Empty state for bulk tool: when no keys selected, show microcopy: "Select keys to rotate or drag a policy onto the list. Tip: start with dev keys." CTA: "Select keys" and keyboard shortcut hint: Shift+K.
Omar (security): Retention: keep rotated secrets for 24h in an encrypted temp store for recovery, but do not display full secrets in UI history. Show only partial hint "starts with: rk_...".
Zoe (a11y): Keyboard flow: after scheduling, focus should move to a results panel so keyboard users can follow status. Announce "Bulk rotation scheduled" via aria-live.
Maya (PM): Great feedback. I'll update mocks to add audit copy, dry-run toggle, and approval gating. Plan to run a quick usability session next sprint. Thanks all :sparkles:
